claim_boundary.scope: Detailed implementation design for zero-copy in-memory transport reference adapter for historical fluid-only references R0081818 and REF-006

mandatory_attributes.coordinate_frame: Must equal config['coordinate_frame'] ('DualSPHysics case Cartesian coordinates (x,y,z)')

access_patterns.chunked_iteration: Loops over particle slices sl = slice(begin, end) with particle_chunk=65536
access_patterns.source_assignment: locate(initial_pos, config['source_regions']) (initial_regions mode: requires 3D position at frame 0)

r0081818_and_ref006: coordinate_frame attribute is missing from native HDF5 root attrs
type and mk datasets are stored as float32 rather than integer types
initial_type and initial_mass datasets are absent
Fixed boundary particles are not stored (only fluid particles are present)
ds_data02_native_labels.materialize() takes a filesystem Path, runs hashlib digest, and calls h5py.File(source, 'r')

concrete_adapter_class_design.architecture_pattern: Duck-typed in-memory proxy wrapping a read-only h5py.File instance
concrete_adapter_class_design.zero_copy_policy: Position, velocity, density, pressure, and valid arrays are accessed directly via h5py dataset slice proxies without allocating duplicate full-trajectory memory buffers.
concrete_adapter_class_design.no_synthetic_fixed_rows_policy: The particle dimension N is strictly N_fluid (26,620 for R0081818, 67,500 for REF-006). The adapter MUST NOT synthesize or insert artificial fixed wall particles (types 0, 1, 2). All N particles are genuine fluid particles.

particle_id.nature: zero-copy direct passthrough (bound to GenCase fluid ranges: 61908..88527 for R0081818, 111708..179207 for REF-006)

type.nature: In-memory virtual array returning integer type 3 (fluid) on arbitrary slices [:, sl] without storing nt*n_fluid bytes on disk

mass.nature: In-memory virtual array returning exact anchor MassFluid (0.0005477085041322314 kg for R0081818, 0.000216 kg for REF-006) on arbitrary slices [:, sl]

initial_type.nature: Lightweight 1D numpy array representing fluid type

initial_mass.nature: Lightweight 1D numpy array matching exact GenCase initial particle mass

initial_mk.nature: Lightweight 1D numpy array indicating MK=1 fluid

non_intrusive_integration_design.boundary_rule: Shared scripts in scripts/ MUST NOT be modified by family delegations.

execution_options_for_root_review.description: Implement the adapter in a dedicated scoped file lagrangian-fluid-lab/campaigns/ds-data-02/families/F3/handoff_20261003/historical_cell3_reuse_v1/audit/f3_fluid_only_transport_adapter_v1.py. The runner imports the canonical mathematical operator functions (validate_config, locate, initial_sources, finite_crossing, chord_box_fraction) directly from scripts/ds_data02_native_labels.py, wraps the native HDF5 with FluidOnlyTransportAdapter, and materializes typed-transport-labels.h5 with identical mathematical and schema contracts.
execution_options_for_root_review.pros: Zero modification to shared repository scripts; fully isolated within Family F3 handoff; 100% mathematical equivalence to canonical operator.
execution_options_for_root_review.cons: Requires a dedicated scoped runner script for fluid-only cases.

execution_options_for_root_review.description: Codex root adds an open_h5_source(source_path_or_adapter) hook to scripts/ds_data02_native_labels.py during global integration, enabling the canonical script to natively accept adapted objects or register adapter plugins.
execution_options_for_root_review.pros: Single unified CLI entrypoint across all cases.
execution_options_for_root_review.cons: Requires primary root code integration and deployment.

non_intrusive_integration_design.recommended_approach: Option A for family-level verification and audit; Option B if primary Codex root desires global standardization.

step_1_schema_contract_audit.method: Instantiate FluidOnlyTransportAdapter on R0081818-NOMINAL.h5 and REF-006.h5; verify all 11 required datasets exist, have correct shapes, and support slicing [:, sl]. Verify attrs['coordinate_frame'] is present.
step_1_schema_contract_audit.pass_criteria: No KeyError or AttributeError; shape[1] == n_fluid; initial_type == 3; initial_mass == MassFluid.

step_2_partvtk_anchor_correspondence.method: Verify positions at frames [0, 418, 835] match the verified PartVTK anchor receipts (r0081818-nominal-partvtk-anchor-audit-001 and ref006-nominal-partvtk-anchor-audit-001).
step_2_partvtk_anchor_correspondence.pass_criteria: Max position residual < 5.0e-9 m; total fluid mass == 14.580000 kg exact.

step_3_dry_run_operator_evaluation.method: Execute canonical crossing and residence operators on the adapted object in memory with output written to a temporary test path; verify zero NaN, zero bracket reversals, and exact mass conservation.
step_3_dry_run_operator_evaluation.pass_criteria: total_initial_mass == 14.580000 kg; destination_time_series values in [-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2]; no unhandled exceptions.

step_4_labels_closure_checks.method: Run the canonical 58-rule label closure suite on the generated labels file.
step_4_labels_closure_checks.pass_criteria: 58/58 checks passed (fluid mass closed, brackets positive, source regions partitioned, unknown/lost/invalid accounting consistent).

step_5_root_signoff_gate.method: Present adapter implementation design, anchor evidence, and validation test results to primary Codex root.
step_5_root_signoff_gate.pass_criteria: Zero label materialization on disk until explicit primary root authorization.
